stories.title: Bitcoin ETFs post $338M inflow, extend six-day streak to $2.26B
stories.summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs added $338 million in one day. The six-day inflow streak now totals $2.26 billion. Combined ETF assets are close to $100 billion.
stories.whyItMatters: Sustained ETF inflows show real institutional demand. They matter more than short-term price swings for tracking who is actually buying bitcoin.
whatToWatch: Whether the inflow streak extends past six days
Whether total ETF assets cross the $100 billion mark
questions: What is driving the renewed inflows?
Will inflows hold up if bitcoin's price pulls back?

stories.title: Bitcoin slips from $80K as gold cools and bond yields fall
stories.summary: Bitcoin topped $80,000, extending a roughly 25% seven-day advance, then slipped as gold cooled and US bond yields fell. Short liquidations passed $220 million in 24 hours during the run to $80K. Traders placed a $2.9 million bet on a fast move above $82,000, while several analysts flagged overbought conditions and said the next pullback will show whether the bear market has really ended.
stories.whyItMatters: A fast rally paired with heavy short liquidations and overbought warnings raises the odds of a sharp reversal, which matters more to this lane than the rally itself.
whatToWatch: Whether bitcoin holds above $80,000
How the next pullback plays out
Whether the $82,000 level traders bet on gets tested
questions: How much of this rally is short covering versus new demand?
Will falling bond yields keep supporting bitcoin, or reverse?

stories.title: Strive buys 1,110 more Bitcoin, holdings top 21,000 BTC
stories.summary: Strive bought 1,110 Bitcoin for about $81.5 million, pushing its total holdings above 21,000 BTC. ASST shares rose 11% on the news. CryptoSlate reported the purchase gave shareholders a real BTC yield of under 2%.
stories.whyItMatters: Corporate treasury buying is a recurring demand source for bitcoin, but a thin per-share yield raises questions about how much these purchases actually benefit holders.
whatToWatch: Whether Strive announces further purchases
Whether ASST shares hold their gain
questions: Does the BTC yield per share justify the pace of buying?
Does this strategy keep working for shareholders as holdings scale up?

stories.title: Bitwise launches self-custodied tokenized stock portfolios with Coinbase
stories.summary: Bitwise launched automated portfolios built on Coinbase's tokenized stock offering. The portfolios cover sectors such as AI, robotics, and tech. Users hold the underlying tokenized shares directly, without a third-party custodian.
stories.whyItMatters: This is a concrete step toward merging traditional equities with crypto infrastructure, a trend that carries real regulatory and adoption implications.
whatToWatch: Investor uptake of the new portfolios
Whether other exchanges launch similar tokenized-stock products
questions: What regulatory framework covers self-custodied tokenized equities?
How does this product differ from existing tokenized stock offerings?

stories.title: Bitcoin futures open interest collapses in a major short squeeze
stories.summary: Bitcoin futures open interest collapsed sharply as a short squeeze forced bearish traders out of their positions. Decrypt put the open interest drop at 12%. CoinDesk called it a short squeeze "for the ages."
stories.whyItMatters: A rapid unwind of leveraged short bets can inflate price moves without matching real demand, which readers should weigh against separate ETF inflow data.
whatToWatch: Whether open interest starts rebuilding
Whether a price pullback follows once the squeeze fully unwinds
questions: Is the squeeze finished, or could it resume?
How much of the recent rally came from the squeeze versus fresh buying?

stories.title: A 3% token move triggers $36 million in Ethereum DeFi liquidations
stories.summary: A roughly 3% price move in one token triggered $36 million in liquidations across Ethereum DeFi protocols, CoinDesk reported. The scale of the liquidations from such a small move points to thin liquidity or high leverage in the affected protocols.
stories.whyItMatters: Outsized liquidations from small price swings are a recurring warning sign about on-chain leverage that this lane's reader should track.
whatToWatch: Which protocols and tokens face further liquidations if volatility continues
questions: Which token and protocols were involved?
Is this an isolated event or a sign of broader over-leverage in DeFi?

stories.title: Ethereum's new 2,048 ETH staking rule could delay reward withdrawals
stories.summary: Ethereum adopted a new rule that sets validator activation batches at 2,048 ETH. CryptoSlate reported this could lock up staking rewards for users longer than expected, by changing how fast validators enter or exit the queue.
stories.whyItMatters: Staking queue mechanics affect liquidity and yield timing for a large share of ETH holders, making this a material technical change, not just a minor tweak.
whatToWatch: How exchanges and staking providers adjust their processes
Validator queue times after the change takes effect
questions: When does the rule take effect?
How much longer will typical reward withdrawals take?

stories.title: Grayscale launches Zcash ETF after critical privacy flaw hit the token
stories.summary: Grayscale launched a Zcash ETF, Decrypt reported, shortly after a critical flaw in Zcash's privacy protocol came to light. The report ties the launch timing directly to the disclosed vulnerability.
stories.whyItMatters: Launching a regulated fund around a privacy coin right after a security flaw raises real questions about investor risk disclosure and due diligence timing.
whatToWatch: Whether Zcash's team confirms a fix for the flaw
Any regulatory response to the launch timing
questions: Was the flaw fixed before the ETF launched?
Did the flaw affect any user funds or transactions?
